slot.brief: Identify which carbonyl compound gives a positive Tollens' test but negative iodoform/Fehling distinction among simple options.

stem: Which compound gives a silver mirror with Tollens' reagent but gives negative results with both Fehling's solution and the iodoform test?

verdicts.working: Benzaldehyde gives a positive Tollens test but is negative with Fehling’s solution and the iodoform test. The other options fail at least one condition.

working:
Benzaldehyde is an aldehyde, so it gives a positive Tollens' test.
Aromatic aldehydes do not reduce Fehling's solution.
Benzaldehyde has no $text{CH}_3text{CO}-$ group and gives a negative iodoform test.
